label: Patient need
description: Size of the residual population plus morbidity mortality and quality-of-life burden after current care. Scored 1-5 with a written rubric in docs/scoring-rubrics.md.

label: Treatment gap
description: Availability of effective therapies residual disease despite treatment excluded populations and treatment burden.

label: Competitive white space
description: Number of active well-resourced programs development-stage concentration and competing mechanisms against that specific problem.

label: Scientific / clinical tractability
description: Biological rationale measurable endpoint biomarker availability and therapeutic precedent.

label: Economic / commercial relevance
description: Chronicity healthcare-resource burden and plausible payer value. Not a TAM forecast.

label: Momentum / why now
description: Enabling technologies regulatory changes demographics or recent scientific advances that change feasibility.
